description: Pre-E9 hide-mask footprint rasterized to a 1024x1024 0/255 mask. Committed so the gate reads no git history (cap27 A1.4).
derivationCommand: sh -c 'git show 0ad5234d0d4883ca38346356ae3c16670e8eea1b:apps/ui-xr/public/generated-humanoids/mpfb-clinical-nurse-adult.glb > /tmp/p2e-pre-e9-0ad5234d0.glb && mise exec -- python3 -I tools/openclinxr/evidence/skin-footprint-inpaint/inpaint_hide_footprint.py derive-fixture --footprint-glb /tmp/p2e-pre-e9-0ad5234d0.glb --out-mask tools/openclinxr/evidence/skin-footprint-inpaint/fixtures/pre-e9-footprint-mask.png'
rasterRule: glTF UV x=u*W, y=v*H, origin top-left, pixel centres inside, no dilation (same as store st-teeth/skin-audit-2/scripts/measure.py; verified byte-identical to its --out-mask output)
rasterOf: TEXCOORD_0 of every openclinxr_hidden_ primitive of the body mesh in the pre-E9 GLB
